final: WITH c AS (SELECT cu.gender AS gender, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM Orders o JOIN Customers cu ON cu.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.date_order_placed > '2013-10-25 17:40:25' AND o.date_order_placed < '2017-05-24 19:26:44' GROUP BY cu.gender) SELECT gender, cnt AS order_count, cnt - (SELECT AVG(cnt) FROM c) AS above_average FROM c WHERE cnt > (SELECT AVG(cnt) FROM c)
